reviewContext: President-authorized compilation of human-language SETKA principles into a machine-readable self-knowledge and deterministic ship-building substrate, including a normalized intent boundary, machine kernel law/capability registry, deterministic blueprint compiler, bounded self-development proposal compiler, Newton attractor-basin diagnostics, power-law scaling diagnostics and pre-scale evidence rules; implementation is offline GitHub kernel work only and does not touch Supabase/PostgreSQL or relax cryosleep/recovery gates
reviewedSemantics: the machine-readable kernel now expresses the primary SETKA laws as a versioned registry: causal irreducibility, structural irreducibility, computational irreducibility, minimum sufficient disclosure, quadratic generative geometry, logistic/quadratic bifurcation linkage, Feigenbaum asymptotic scaling, attractor-basin analysis, power-law scaling and Least Verified Action

the machine kernel is a deterministic contract and does not require an AI model to read or reinterpret its own declared laws; a complete SETKA_SHIP_INTENT_V1 compiles into a SETKA_SHIP_BLUEPRINT_V1 without an AI call

arbitrary free-form human language is not falsely claimed to be deterministically unambiguous; free text crosses an explicit semantic-normalization boundary that may be implemented by a deterministic UI, a human or AI, and the normalizer is not allowed to invent or override kernel laws

the ship compiler always includes base identity, causal memory, replay, provenance, runtime safety and self-diagnostic organs, expands only capabilities declared by the machine kernel, and fails closed to REVIEW_REQUIRED on unknown capability tokens instead of inventing an organ

compiled blueprints reference versioned kernel laws rather than copying the whole kernel into every ship; the derived blueprint stores ship-specific purpose, parameters and constraints and has canonicalMutationAuthorized=false until separate verification and authority gates pass

the self-development compiler turns known deterministic diagnostic signals into candidate changes and required proof protocols; it does not mutate code or canon by itself and every compiled proposal starts accepted=false and canonicalMutationPerformed=false

bounded runtime tuning classes such as materialization resolution, counterfactual sampling density and verified local execution-plan selection may be marked eligible inside an already authorized law envelope, but eligibility is not implementation or acceptance and does not bypass safety, Least Verified Action, recovery or provenance rules

kernel-law changes, new canonical storage surfaces, privacy/authority policy changes, cryosleep/recovery changes, destructive canonical changes and new mandatory-vendor changes remain externally authorized and cannot be self-accepted by the kernel

Newton iteration z_next=z-f(z)/f_prime(z) is implemented as the first method of a general attractor-basin diagnostic rather than as a replacement ship-geometry law; polynomial evaluation, derivatives, complex Newton steps and root-attractor classification are deterministic FLOAT64_JS_V1-style numeric primitives

the Newton basin analyzer operates on an explicit finite sample set and returns attractor assignment, convergence state, iterations, residual and a sampled nearest-different-attractor distance estimate; it explicitly declares sampledOnly=true, exactBoundaryProven=false and globalConvergenceProven=false

basin-boundary proximity is therefore a diagnostic refinement signal for counterfactual sampling/materialization, not an exact proof of a fractal basin boundary; deep-basin folding and near-boundary refinement remain policy decisions subject to evidence and cost

power-law scaling is implemented as an empirical candidate model Y=C*X^alpha fitted in log space over positive samples; the fit reports alpha, C, observed range, R-squared and log-RMSE but remains status=CANDIDATE_ONLY and canonicalTruth=false

a visually straight log-log relation or high R-squared does not certify a power law; consequential use requires an explicit alternative-model-comparison PASS, declared valid scale range and bounded uncertainty/evidence contract

uncertified power-law projections deliberately emit ESTIMATED_UNBOUNDED evidence, which existing Least Verified Action rules send to REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than allowing a cheap-looking extrapolation to silently win
certified power-law use is limited to the declared range; extrapolation outside that range returns REVIEW_REQUIRED and no implementation claims a universal scale law from finite observations

the intended scale organ measures how canonical storage, compute, network, AI calls, branch cost, recovery cost, parent memory and knowledge gain change with fleet/world scale; alpha>1 is only a superlinear-risk candidate signal, not automatic causal proof

the machine build pipeline is HUMAN_REQUEST -> SEMANTIC_NORMALIZATION -> SETKA_SHIP_INTENT_V1 -> DETERMINISTIC_SHIP_COMPILER -> CANDIDATE_BLUEPRINT -> COUNTERFACTUAL_OR_STATIC_VERIFICATION -> LEAST_VERIFIED_ACTION_SELECTION -> AUTHORITY_GATE -> COMMIT_OR_REJECT -> APPEND_ONLY_PROVENANCE

the self-development loop is MEASURE -> DETECT -> COMPILE_CANDIDATE -> COUNTERFACTUAL_BRANCH -> TEST_INVARIANTS -> COMPARE_BASELINE -> LEAST_VERIFIED_ACTION -> AUTHORITY_GATE -> APPEND_ONLY_PROVENANCE, so self-development is bounded evolution rather than silent self-rewrite

Kernel Map now registers a high-criticality ship_compiler component and SHIP_KERNEL_COMPILER check group; generative_geometry review targets include Newton-basin sampling semantics and least_verified_action review targets include power-law evidence/range semantics
